card.name: Linking words before amount or extent
card.fires_on: Small linking words (or, and, in, to, with, than) right where the next word is likely to be amount, quantity, extent, dose or duration. Seen in drug-label text on absorption, overdose and substitution.

modes.label: Pairs with rate or speed
modes.description: The word 'or' or 'and' after rate or speed, before extent or duration.
modes.example: both the rate<< and>> extent of absorption are significantly increased

modes.label: Result or lead in
modes.description: Words like in, to or with after result, lead or reported, before an amount-related outcome such as overdosage.
modes.example: could lead<< to>> overdosage. Use the lowest effective

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like quantity, amount and extent, and away from price words.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a word like amount or extent is about to come next.
